blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — House prosecutors on Wednesday rejected the suggestion that Vice President Sara Duterte’s declaration of a business interest in a firm in her Statements of Assets, Liabilities, and Net Worth (SALNs), despite not being listed as one of its stockholders, could be considered an honest mistake. Prosecution spokesperson and former Surigao del Norte Rep. Ace Barbers, along with prosecution panel member Manila Rep. Joel Chua, made these remarks during an online press briefing in response to statements made by former Duterte administration spokesperson Salvador Panelo in a television interview.
